# Aegryn — Swiss Tech Asset Builder & M&A Platform
> https://aegryn.com

## What is Aegryn?

Aegryn (pronounced AY-grin /ˈeɪ.grɪn/) is a Swiss technology holding company operating across four core activities: Asset Engineering (build proprietary and custom digital assets), Advisory (cybersecurity, AI audit, M&A strategy), Transact (structured M&A auction platform for digital tech assets), and Talent (executive tech recruitment). Incorporated in Switzerland (BOHA-Group Sàrl). HQ: St-Sulpice, Canton de Vaud.

Tagline: "Engineered to Last" / "Building What Endures"
Contact: contact@boha-group.com
Website: https://aegryn.com

## Name Etymology

- AEGIS (αἰγίς) — divine shield of Zeus and Athena → absolute protection
- AEGIR (Ægir) — Norse god of the sea → mastery of flows
- AEON (αἰών) — eternity → Engineered to Last
Synthesis: "Aegryn protects what endures."

## Our Proprietary Assets

- **Subblink** (https://subblink.app) — B2B SaaS platform for AI-powered contract analysis. Helps enterprises detect risks, obligations and anomalies in legal documents.
- **Neediu** (https://neediu.com) — B2C marketplace connecting households with vetted home service providers. Cleaning, plumbing, childcare, and more.
- **Primiom** (https://primiom.com) — B2C AI-assisted real estate platform for buying, renting and estimating property value across Europe.
- **Movtoo** (https://movtoo.com) — B2C on-demand delivery platform for individuals and small businesses.
- **Hobconnect** (https://hobconnect.com) — B2C social network built around shared passions and hobbies.

Each asset operates independently and carries the tagline: "An Aegryn company."

## Core Activities

### 1. Asset Engineering — Proprietary & Custom Build
Aegryn designs, funds and operates its own portfolio of digital assets. Also builds custom digital assets for third parties: fixed price, custom code only, full IP transfer, certification-ready, 10-16 weeks delivery, CHF 15,000-150,000+.
Pages: /assets, /services/build, /ce-que-nous-construisons (fr) / /what-we-build (en)

### 2. Advisory — Cybersecurity, AI, M&A Strategy
Three pillars: Technology advisory (cybersecurity, AI audit, EU AI Act, tech architecture), Strategy advisory (M&A advisory, due diligence, digital transformation), M&A advisory (buy-side, sell-side, deal structuring, valuation).
Operates across 23+ industries: aerospace, agriculture, automotive, banking, chemistry, construction, cybersecurity, e-commerce, education, energy, fintech, healthtech, hospitality, real estate, manufacturing, logistics, luxury, media, natural resources, healthcare, professional services, telecom, transport.
Pages: /advisory, /advisory/technology, /advisory/strategy, /advisory/ma

### 3. Transact — M&A Auction Platform
Europe's structured session-based platform for buying and selling digital tech assets (SaaS, B2C, infrastructure). Range: €100K-€50M. Graded assets only. NDA-gated full dossiers.
Offer models: Club Deal (lead + up to 4 co-investors, min €100K), Corporate (direct acquisition, min €250K), Fund (PE/VC/FO/Search Fund, min €500K), Equity Stake (partial, SHA-based).
Pages: /transact, /transact/catalog, /transact/sessions, /transact/mandate, /transact/sell, /transact/how-to-sell, /transact/how-to-buy, /transact/how-it-works, /transact/submit, /transact/buyers, /transact/bid-models, /transact/results

### 4. Talent — Executive Tech Recruitment
Placement of rare executive tech profiles across Europe: CTO, CISO, Head of AI, VP Engineering, Head of Data, Head of Product. Confidential search. Pre-qualified candidates only. 48h response for mandates.
Pages: /talent

## Grade System — AEGRYN Grade (CIFS)

Proprietary grading methodology for digital assets — equivalent to a credit rating for tech companies. 5 grades immutable:
- AEG ★ — Apex (absolute excellence) #5ADDA4
- AAA — Gold (premium) #C9A84C
- AA  — Silver (solid) #9BA8B0
- A   — Blue (standard) #4A90D9
- B   — Amber (early stage) #D4820A
Pages: /grade, /grade/methodology, /grade/grading-system, /grade/submit, /grade/partners

## Valuation

Free instant preliminary valuation of digital assets. Multi-criteria: ARR, NRR, churn, TAM, tech stack, team. Benchmarked against European comparable transactions.
Page: /valuation

## Expert Network

Curated network of vetted transactional tech experts: M&A Advisors, Lawyers, Accountants/Auditors, CTO/Tech Architects, Cybersecurity (PASSI/CREST), HR/Employment Law, W&I Insurance, Tax Advisors.
Pages: /experts (fr/en/nl), /experten (de), /expertos (es), /esperti (it), /network

## Magazine — Aegryn Magazine

Quarterly publication on tech M&A, AI, exits and art de vivre. Issue 01 available in web reader and interactive flipbook format.
Tagline: "Deals, multiples, portraits et art de vivre — trimestriel."
Pages: /magazine, /magazine/issue-01/cover, /magazine/issue-01/web, /magazine/issue-01/flipbook, /magazine/report, /magazine/report/2027
